author: CNN
description:
The talks between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump have struck a broadly positive tone so far, with Trump calling his counterpart a “friend,” and the two leaders agreeing to establish a new “constructive, strategic, stable relationship,” according to the Chinese foreign ministry. 

Amid all the talk of cooperation and collaboration, however, one statement stood out: a stark warning from Xi about what’s at stake if the US crosses its so-called red line on the sensitive topic of Taiwan.

CNN senior international correspondent Will Ripley shares Taiwan’s response to Xi’s statement. Also, CNN political analyst Maggie Haberman, Rep. Mark Alford (R-MO) and Sen. Chris Coons (D-DE) give their reactions to Xi’s warning about Taiwan.  

0:00 CNN’s Will Ripley reports from Taipei as Xi warns Trump over Taiwan 
3:37 Maggie Haberman on Trump’s view of Taiwan 
4:54 GOP rep. says negotiations with Taiwan are “a delicate tap dance”  
7:44 Dem senator says he thinks Xi has Trump
title: China issues stark new warning to Trump on Taiwan
